newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines Feb value of production index up.
newsitem.headline: Philippines Feb value of production index up.

text.p: The Philippines' value of production index inched up 0.1 percent in February to 453.0 from 452.5 in the same period last year, the National Statistics Office said on Friday.
However, the volume of production index slipped by 1.8 percent to 151.5 from 154.3 posted a year ago.
The fall in the volume of production index was an improvement fromthe around 8.0 percent drops in both December and January, the statistics centre said in a statement.
The indices are the results of the survey of key enterprises in manufacturing, a monthly survey aimed at providing flash indicators on the performance of the manufacturing industry.
The month-on-month rise in the value of production index was 10.4 percent from 410.4 in January.
The volume of production index rose 10 percent from 137.8 in January.
Companies involved in electrical machinery posted the heftiest increases with their production value up by 28.8 percent and production volume up by 29.5 percent.
Textile companies suffered one the biggest losses with production value falling 30.9 percent, and volume, 28.5 percent.
Clothing makers also posted a 40.3 percent decline in their production volume, and 16.3 percent in their production value.
